A record is invalid when the information cutoff (`known_as_of`) is later than the prediction timestamp (`predicted_at`). The contract requires `known_as_of <= predicted_at`. A later cutoff would mean the prediction used information learned after it was made. Source: vault://evaluation.polymarket/prediction_ledger_contract sha256:6ff16921ca49 L1-L41 (the field rule and integrity rule 5).

ANSWER_PATH: vault://evaluation.polymarket/prediction_ledger_contract
ANSWER: `known_as_of > predicted_at` is invalid, because it would use information learned after the prediction. `known_as_of` must be `<= predicted_at`.
